title: GitHub Notes Viewer — Note Content Contract
description: The shape of a single note after fetching via the Contents API and splitting front matter. Feeds both the Note entity (data-model.md) and the rendered output pipeline.

raw_github_response.name: string — filename including extension
raw_github_response.url: string — API URL for this file
raw_github_response.html_url: string — direct GitHub UI URL (not used by the app)
raw_github_response.git_url: string — git blob URL (not used by the app)
raw_github_response.download_url: string — direct raw download URL; unused because we decode base64 client-side
raw_github_response.lastModified: string — RFC 3339 timestamp of HEAD commit for this path

path.description: Identity key. Matches the TreeNode.path for the corresponding leaf.

filename.description: Basenames extracted from path. Used as title fallback.

title.description: Final display title. Comes from YAML front matter 'title' key if present; otherwise slugified filename stem.

content.description: Raw markdown text after base64 decode. Piped through marked → DOMPurify for rendering.

frontMatter.description: Parsed YAML keys from gray-matter. Treated as metadata only — never rendered as part of the note body. Accessible on the entity for future features like date sorting but not consumed in v1.

sha.description: Blob SHA. Mirrors the tree node sha for consistency checks.

lastModified.description: Commit date string from the API. Rendered as-is in the reading view header.

etag.description: ETag response header value, stored verbatim for use as If-None-Match on subsequent fetches within the session.

fetchedAt.description: Local clock time when this note was last fetched. Updated even on 304 responses.

app_parsed_note.title_fallback_logic: if frontMatter.title exists and is non-empty string, use it; else strip .md suffix from filename and preserve existing capitalization/punctuation

conditional_request_flow.on_200: replace note.content with new decoded content; update etag, sha, lastModified, fetchedAt
conditional_request_flow.on_304: do NOT mutate note.content; update only fetchedAt; return existing Note object unchanged
conditional_request_flow.on_non_retryable_error: set ReadingViewState.error per FR-008; show retry button

steps: Prism.highlightAll() called post-insert for code block re-highlighting
markdown_rendering_pipeline.sanitization_policy: DOMPurify default sanitize mode with hooks disabled; no user-controlled iframe/srcdoc allowed. Links open in new tab via rel=noreferrer noopener when target is external.

rate_limit_considerations.secondary_limit_caution: ~80 content reads/min burst; ETag caching limits repeated reads to once-per-session per note in practice
rate_limit_considerations.header_watch: X-RateLimit-Remaining logged to console during development; silently handled at runtime by respecting 304s
